newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti to divest PC unit by year-end.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti to divest PC unit by year-end.

text.p: Troubled Italian information and technology group Olivetti will divest its Personal Computer division and other units by the end of this year in an operation expected to raise 800 billion lire ($526.3 million), CEO Roberto Colaninno told a meeting of analysts on Thursday. ($1=1520 Lire)
